lines: By that quick filling, crown-end broken, brow-toss bridge:
thought-free mind made — above all, all go forth.
sanskrit_cite: tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā | nirvikalpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā sarvordhve sarvagodgamaḥ

lines: Peacock feathers, varied forms, circles — five-void:
of the meditating, unsurpassed void: entry in heart.
sanskrit_cite: śikhipakṣaiś citrarūpair ma.ṅdalaiḥ śūnyapañcakam | dhyāyato 'nuttare śūnye praveśo hṛdaye bhavet

lines: By just such course — wherever thought: void, wall,
supreme, vessel: self dissolved, boon-giving.
sanskrit_cite: īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā | śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā

lines: Mind in skull placed, half-closed-eyed standing:
from mind's firmness in order — mark the highest mark.
sanskrit_cite: kapālāntar mano nyasya tiṣṭhan mīlitalocanaḥ | krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam

lines: Middle channel, mid-standing, lotus-fiber-like:
by meditated inner sky, Goddess — god shines through.
sanskrit_cite: madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā | dhyātāntarvyomayā devyā tayā devaḥ prakāśate

lines: Hand-blocked gaze, brow-split, door-blocked:
seen in drop, dissolved in order — middle, supreme standing.
sanskrit_cite: kararuddhadṛgastreṇa bhrūbhedād dvārarodhanāt | dṛṣṭe bindau kramāl līne tanmadhye paramā sthitiḥ

lines: Dwelling-inner-churn's fire-tilak, drop at crest's end,
heart, dissolution-end: meditating, dissolving.
sanskrit_cite: dhāmāntaḥkṣobhasambhūtasūkṣmāgnitilakākṛtim | binduṃ śikhānte hṛdaye layānte dhyāyato layaḥ

lines: Unstruck, vessel-ear, broken sound, river-rushing:
bathed in word-brahman — supreme brahman attained.
sanskrit_cite: anāhate pātrakarṇe 'bhagnaśabde sariddrute | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahmādhigacchati

lines: Prolonged oṃ-uttering, at its end, void contemplated:
by void, by supreme power — to voidness goes, Bhairavī.
sanskrit_cite: praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte śūnyabhāvānāt | śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi

lines: Any letter's beginning and end contemplated:
by void become void — void-formed the man becomes.
sanskrit_cite: yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet | śūnyayā śūnyabhūto 'sau śūnyākāraḥ pumān bhavet
